unauthorized.description: The bot token is invalid or has been revoked.

flood_wait.description: Too Many Requests: hit flood limit, wait retry_after seconds.

conflict_webhook_active.pattern: /can't use getUpdates method while webhook is active/i
conflict_webhook_active.description: Can't use getUpdates while a webhook is active.

conflict_terminated_by_other_get_updates.description: Terminated by another getUpdates request (multiple bot instances running).

file_too_large.pattern: /(request entity too large|file is too big|file exceeds the size limit)/i
file_too_large.description: Uploaded file exceeds the maximum size limit.

bot_blocked.description: The bot was blocked by the user.

bot_kicked.pattern: /(bot was kicked|bot is not a member)/i
bot_kicked.description: The bot is not a member of the chat or was kicked.

user_deactivated.description: The target user account was deleted or deactivated.

bot_cant_initiate_conversation.pattern: /bot can't initiate conversation with a user/i
bot_cant_initiate_conversation.description: Bot can't initiate conversation with a user who hasn't started the bot.

business_connection_revoked.description: The business connection was revoked by the user.

not_enough_rights.pattern: /(not enough rights|bot is not an administrator)/i
not_enough_rights.description: The bot lacks required administrative rights or permissions.

chat_not_found.description: The specified chat_id was not found or is inaccessible.

user_not_found.description: The specified user was not found.

user_already_participant.description: The user is already a member of the chat.

message_not_modified.description: Message content and reply markup are identical to current content.

message_not_found.pattern: /message( to delete| to forward)? not found/i
message_not_found.description: The specified message was not found.

message_cant_be_deleted.description: Message cannot be deleted (e.g. 48-hour limit expired or no rights).

message_empty.description: Message text or content is empty.

message_too_long.description: Message text exceeds the maximum character limit.

cant_parse_entities.description: Failed to parse text formatting entities with current parse_mode.

reply_message_not_found.description: The message specified in reply_parameters was not found.

topic_not_modified.description: Topic name or icon is unchanged.

wrong_file_type.description: The file format or MIME type is not accepted for this method.

photo_invalid_dimensions.description: Photo dimensions exceed or violate allowed aspect ratio.

voice_messages_forbidden.description: The recipient has disabled voice messages in their privacy settings.

media_empty.description: The media container or media array is empty.

button_data_invalid.description: Callback button data is invalid or exceeds 64 bytes.

button_url_invalid.description: The URL provided in an inline button is invalid.

reply_markup_invalid.description: The reply_markup JSON structure is invalid.

commands_list_empty.description: Passing empty commands array; use deleteMyCommands instead.

command_too_long.description: Command name exceeds 32 chars or description exceeds 256 chars.

command_invalid.description: Command names must start with a letter and contain only a-z, 0-9, and _.

invalid_language_code.description: Invalid language code; must be 2-letter ISO 639-1.

query_id_invalid.description: Query is too old or query_id is invalid.

business_connection_not_found.description: The specified business_connection_id was not found.

stickerset_invalid.description: The sticker set is invalid or does not exist.

sticker_emoji_invalid.description: The emoji provided for the sticker is invalid.

sticker_dimensions_invalid.description: Sticker dimensions must be exactly 512x512 pixels.

stars_amount_invalid.description: Invalid amount of Telegram Stars (must be between 1 and 25000).

date_too_far.description: Scheduled date is too far in the future (max 30 days).

date_in_past.description: Scheduled date cannot be in the past.
